    last_source_col += 1

last_source_row = header_row
for r in range(header_row + 1, ws.max_row + 1):
    if any(ws.cell(r, c).value is not None for c in range(first_col, last_source_col + 1)):
        last_source_row = r

first_letter = get_column_letter(first_col)

formula = (
    f'=COUNTIF('
    f'INDEX(${first_letter}$2:${last_letter}${last_source_row},0,'
    f'MATCH($I$1,${first_letter}$1:${last_letter}$1,0)),'
    f'$I$2)'
)

# Modify only the required answer cell.
ws["I3"] = formula

# Ensure formulas are recalculated when opened by spreadsheet software.

    wb.calculation.fullCalcOnLoad = True
    wb.calculation.forceFullCalc = True
